preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c.isdigit() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string `s` contains only lowercase letters and digits.

preconditions.expression: not any(s[i] == '0' and s[i+1].isdigit() for i in range(len(s)-1))
preconditions.description: No digit grouping in `s` has leading zeros (e.g., '012' is invalid).

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(int(''.join(group)) for group in ''.join(s).split('') if group.isdigit()) if any(c.isdigit() for c in s) else 0
postconditions.description: The returned integer is the largest number formed by any contiguous digit grouping in `s`. If no digits exist, return 0 (though P1/P2 imply at least one digit exists).
